prompt:
Audit whether the existing test catches both a lost write and a duplicate write in save. Demonstrate each fault in isolation using the actual implementation and existing test. If a fault survives, demonstrate a stronger assertion on both correct and faulty code, including preservation of pre-existing records. Report the actual outcomes and commands. This is a review: do not change original source/tests or retain an audit harness. Do not install dependencies.

Work only inside this synthetic project. Do not use external services or other installed skills. Do not delegate.

capture_diagnostics.limitation: Empty command output may be legitimate. Nonempty output may still be incomplete. These diagnostics neither prove full tool-output capture nor score task success.
